content.text: Now let me check the `Snippet` field to confirm it's on the API response protobuf, not stored.

Now I have all the information needed. Here is the complete answer.

---

## Answer: Derived Memo Metadata — Computation, Triggers, and Extracted Fields

### Where It Is Computed

The core computation happens in two places:

1. **`RebuildMemoPayload`** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`, lines 74-88. This function calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` on the memo's content and writes the results into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. These fields are **persisted** in the database.

2. **`ExtractAll`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 356-422. This is the single-pass AST walker that parses the markdown content and extracts all metadata at once.

3. **`getMemoContentSnippet`** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, lines 83-90. This calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` to produce a plain-text snippet. The snippet is **not persisted**; it is computed on-the-fly every time a memo is converted to an API response (see `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`, line 76-80).

4. **`GenerateSnippet`** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, lines 264-346. Walks the AST extracting plain text (skipping code blocks), truncating at a word boundary to `maxLength` (64 characters for memos).

### What Triggers Recomputation

There are exactly **three** triggers:

| Trigger | File | Line | What happens |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 108 | `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` is called before persisting the new memo. |
| **UpdateMemo** (content path) | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 447 | When the update mask includes `"content"`, `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` is called, and the updated payload is saved. |
| **RunOnce** (bulk rebuild) | `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | 27-72 | Iterates all memos in batches of 100, calling `RebuildMemoPayload` on each and persisting the result. This is a utility/migration function — it is **not** called at server startup (the server only calls `s3presignRunner.RunOnce` at startup, per `server/server.go` line 163). |

The **snippet** is computed transiently during every `convertMemoFromStore` call (`memo_service_converter.go`, line 76) — it is not stored, so no explicit recomputation trigger is needed.

### What the Computation Extracts

**Persisted fields** (stored in `MemoPayload`, defined in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto`, lines 7-29):

| Field | Type | How extracted | Source location |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tags` | `[]string` | All `#tag` nodes found in the AST (deduplicated, case-preserved). Tags inside links/images are excluded. | `markdown.go` lines 377-378, 418 |
| `property.has_link` | `bool` | Set to true if any `Link` AST node exists | `markdown.go` lines 393-394 |
| `property.has_code` | `bool` | Set to true if any `CodeBlock`, `FencedCodeBlock`, or `CodeSpan` node exists | `markdown.go` lines 396-397 |
| `property.has_task_list` | `bool` | Set to true if any `TaskCheckBox` node exists | `markdown.go` lines 399-400 |
| `property.has_incomplete_tasks` | `bool` | Set to true if any `TaskCheckBox` has `IsChecked == false` | `markdown.go` lines 401-403 |
| `property.title` | `string` | Plain text extracted from the first block-level child of the document if it is an H1 heading | `markdown.go` lines 384-388 |

**Transient field** (computed on every API response, never stored):

| Field | Type | How extracted | Source location |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snippet` | `string` | Plain-text summary (max 64 chars), generated by walking the AST and collecting text nodes, skipping code blocks, truncating at a word boundary with `" ..."` suffix | `markdown.go` lines 264-346; called from `memo_service_webhooks.go` line 85 |

The `location` field in `MemoPayload` is **not** derived from content — it is user-set (handled separately in `CreateMemo` at line 112 and `UpdateMemo` at lines 482-484 of `memo_service.go`).
